verdict.rationale: Fly.io states that a Sprite's disk "grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there," which matches both halves of the story. Its general pay-as-you-go statement (only paying for storage actually used) supports this. The evidence is a single marketing line scoped to Sprites, with a 100 GB ceiling. Missing for 10: in-depth billing/storage docs (per-GB rates, measurement granularity, whether deleted data shrinks billing), evidence that the same behavior applies to Fly Machines/Volumes rather than only Sprites, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
